limitations: Controlled-workflow recorder, not a hostile-operator security boundary.
Filesystem failure can prevent new receipt writes; existing start/log artifacts remain preserved.
Syntax and source review do not establish runtime execution success, actual CI completion or scientific validity.
repairs: Every recorder Git invocation uses the bounded git wrapper, including ls-remote. Full state validates HEAD/branch/remote/runtime/production guard before and after both fixed commands.

Launch, timeout, independent after-snapshot, full post-state and public-validation errors retain closed execution receipts. Unknown state stays null; no failure continues to run 2. Outer errors emit a closed stopped summary and retain a stopped receipt after the exclusive attempt directory exists.

Before forwarding output, exact report/exposure keys, strict types, closed categories/stages/local scope, fixed object/capture/prerequisite identities, causal exposure flags and blocked scientific scope are validated against source.

Original dbb source and both failed static reviews remain unchanged. Actual two diagnose argv and 100-second operation timeout remain fixed. Owned child processes are killed/reaped after timeout/interruption; proxy/CA environment retained while Python import overrides are removed.
